title: Counterfeit Cash
content: For the first time, somehow I ended up using cash in Mall World inside a college campus. I don't remember what I was buying, but I do remember my USD turning into coupons with dollar signs or turning into different currencies. It's as if it was strange magic tricks every time I was paying for something. I ended up embarrassed with what was going on and I didn't want to be seen as a "scammer". Then moments later I woke up realizing that I was being tricked. I don't know how I mostly forget about my dreams, but I was still able to remember about my changing currencies, denominations, and/or cash texture.
